label: Severe ocular proptosis
article_title: Case report: A girl with witnessed sleep apnea.
quote: Physical features of this girl showed the child’s wide and flat skull deformity, large eye slits, wide interocular distance, protruding eyeballs, bilateral exotropia, absence of upper eyelid ptosis, small and low nasal bridge (A).

label: Severe ocular proptosis
quote: Type 2 consists of cloverleaf skull, Pfeiffer hands and feet, severe exorbitism, central nervous system involvement, elbow ankylosis or synostosis.
